in_greek.name: Αρρών
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name אהרון (Aharon), meaning 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted mountain'. In Greek mythology, Arron was an epithet of the god Helios, representing the golden mountain of the sun.

in_latin.name: Aaron
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name אהרון (Aharon), meaning 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted mountain'. In Latin, Aaron is simply the Romanized form of the Hebrew name.
